description: This file defines the PasswordHasher class, which implements password hashing functionality using HMACSHA512. It provides methods to hash passwords with a salt asynchronously and handles resource disposal.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: A class that provides password hashing functionality using HMACSHA512 with salt support.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronously hashes a password combined with a salt using HMACSHA512.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources used by the HMACSHA512 instance.
